asset.name: Spinner
asset.description: The restrained indeterminate progress indicator with size, accessible label, appearance delay, contrast handling, and reduced-motion behavior.

requires.reason: Every spacing, size, and radius value resolves to a declared ramp rather than a literal.
Motion policy is resolved through the shared hook so the preference can be overridden and tested.
User-facing copy resolves through the adopting host locale bridge.

suggests.reason: Delaying appearance avoids flashes on fast work, but a spinner shown deliberately needs no delay.
